text: おなかに　こどもを　いれて　そだてて　います！

structure.jp: おなかに　こどもを　いれて
structure.en: putting its child in its belly

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on or is done as a habit; います is the polite form. そだてて　います = 'is raising'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next and here shows how the second is done. こどもを　いれて = 'putting its child in, and'.
